newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals, except zinc and lead, suffer losses.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals, except zinc and lead, suffer losses.

text.p: Indian metals', barring zinc and lead, suffered fresh losses on Tuesday on low industrial demand and with state firms remaining active sellers, dealers said.

Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 11,600 rupees per quintal, nickel lost 300 rupees at 37,400 and tin was down 100 rupees at 35,500. Aluminium fell by 100 rupees to 7,250 rupees on selling pressure following lower world market trends.

"Some local aluminium producers were considering reducing selling prices but so far they have only offered discounts on basic prices," one broker said. Lead and zinc were unchanged at 4,925 rupees and 6,200, respectively.
